brand_prompt: Andaz Vibe Stay in Arambol Goa: six-page, real-photo, sunwashed editorial hostel website. Gemini review identified thin Home, bland mobile nav, low-contrast links, cramped cards, fake room-as-food imagery. Correct those problems. Use authentic approved Andaz gold logo, real room photo only for stays. No invented food/pool images. SOURCE_ONLY.
full_brief: VERIFIED REVIEW FEEDBACK — GitHub Actions #43570601078: 12/12 real Gemini screenshot critiques; 31 issues, chiefly contrast (10), imagery (7), hierarchy (6), spacing (6). This is evidence-based advice, NOT a scored release certificate. The previous homepage had only one content section, an unfinished placeholder, plain vertical mobile navigation and too much empty cream space at desktop. The old Experiences and Food pages misused a bedroom picture as a pool/meal image. Reject and redesign from verified owner facts, never copy old generated HTML/CSS. Need true editorial art direction with healthy visual hierarchy and brand-specific, independent components. Never present Andaz as a luxury resort; it is an authentic Arambol hostel/stay. Use owner exact official logo; do not synthesize any image, do not invent photo subjects. No page may use room photo for food or experience imagery. Responsive 320/390/768/1440. 4.5:1 WCAG contrast; warm ink on sand, gold emblem is decorative only, CTAs dark and highly visible. Compact horizontal scrollable MOBILE navigation with enough touch target height (at least 44px), no expanded vertical text list. Desktop nav horizontal, refined. Do not hide important links or add unapproved scripts. Keep WhatsApp clear, visible high contrast and branded, actual fully qualified URL. Appropriate cream background with substantial but not excessive whitespace. One actual verified room photo in Home and truthful bed-type comparisons in Rooms. Food must be an expressive typography-first food editorial page WITHOUT photo of the room, product claims limited to ₹180 dine-in, ₹220 delivered inside Arambol, extra fee outside upon enquiry. Experiences social travel and Moksha partner only; no fake pool imagery. Explore: 12 meaningful known Arambol local destinations with engaging typography-only category badges, never invented photos or distances, preserve functional filters/search. Contact: breathing room, generous form label-field spacing, proper visual H1, exact trusted form IDs and no unsupported inputs or new JS. All six routes connected; one shared stylesheet with actual classes for all. Home >=3 meaningful editorial sections, >=145 words, no placeholder. Rooms >=2 sections, Experiences >=3, Food >=2, Explore >=1, Contact >=2. Review source factual honesty independently. SOURCE_ONLY; no production, no artistic score or signed certification until owner trust.
css_task: Create a distinctive, COMPLETE responsive CSS design system for six-page authentic Arambol hostel editorial website. Ink-on-cream WCAG AA >=4.5:1, warm sand and strong charcoal, gold emblem as accent only. IMPORTANT .nav-list desktop horizontal and mobile horizontally scrollable compact pills, 44px touch targets; no vertical text-list. Actual styles for .site-header .container .logo .nav-list .hero .grid .card .btn .booking-form .form-group .site-footer .cta; responsive 320/390/768/1440. Bound real room hero, no giant empty margins. Style focus states.
